title: Jumping Spider Enemies created, rigged and animated entirely by Meshy AI! [Early Dev footage]
author: Meshyai

comments.author: Meshyai
comments.body:
Credit: NovaByte. Game engine: Unity  
Note that this is early Game Development Footage and not representative of the final game.

replies.author: thousandlytales
replies.body: I thought meshy can only rig humanoid model?

replies.author: Meshyai
replies.body: Also Quadruped like Dogs, with a walk animation.

comments.author: dragonboltz
comments.body: This looks awesome! It's wild to see characters like this made entirely by an AI tool. I'm using Meshy too for small projects – it's a text to 3D model generator, so you can describe what you want and get a decent low‑poly base to work with. The rigging and animation features mean you can bring them straight into Unity or Unreal and iterate quickly, which is huge for indie devs. Curious to see how you integrated the output into your pipeline.

comments.author: IncorrectAddress
comments.body: This is actually pretty good ! Sure, it looks a bit dated, but it's going to improve !

comments.author: dragonboltz
comments.body: I've mostly been using Meshy for humanoid characters, so it's really neat to see it handle more creature-like rigs like this. The rigging tools make quick prototypes super easy!
